pages.title: The hammer
pages.text: A wave along the floor - jump it.

When he quenches the hammer in a trough he is open - but after it every blow of his freezes and hits harder. The water in the trough is not his; take it before he gets there, and you see him go without. The forge's buckets hang on the wall by the way in.
The tongs seize whoever stands before him; he must be hurt hard to let go. In the cell next door someone waits for the overseer to stop watching.
